# CNS Skills

> An independent, MIT-licensed scientific-writing skill for ChatGPT/Codex,
> Claude Code, and Agent Skills-compatible clients. It revises English or
> Chinese manuscripts while preserving evidence boundaries, and audits claims,
> citations, titles, figures, tables, cross-references, and clean-submission
> DOCX artifacts. Review mode distinguishes graphical abstracts, overviews,
> workflows, frameworks, cross-study evidence synthesis, and roadmaps, with an
> object-based biomedical scene grammar and third-party visual provenance.

Repository: https://github.com/niuyupeng/CNS-Skills
License: https://github.com/niuyupeng/CNS-Skills/blob/main/LICENSE

## Important boundaries

- CNS means Cell, Nature, and Science only as an aspirational editorial
  benchmark; it does not imply affiliation or endorsement.
- The project does not fabricate evidence, guarantee acceptance, replace source
  reading, or optimize for AI-detector evasion.
- Public examples are synthetic. Do not upload confidential manuscripts unless
  the selected host and institutional policy allow it.
